richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Meerut

c: Meerut makes cricket bats, balls and sports gear for much of the country, so people here know their way around a workout. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Meerut for parks, schools, colleges, housing societies and the cantonment's open grounds. We build our Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, about 1170 km away, and send them by road.

Our installation team or a dealer in north India handles the fixing. Western Uttar Pradesh has hot summers, a short monsoon and cold, foggy winters, and galvanised steel copes with all three. Because many Meerut users are young and serious about training, we often suggest a few harder stations alongside the usual twisters and walkers. A mix like that keeps both groups using the same gym without crowding each other.

items.q: Is a Cross Fit frame suitable for a school or college in Meerut?
items.a: Yes, for older students. It needs more clear space than single machines, and we mark that space on the layout drawing so it does not overlap with paths or other stations.

items.q: Can we mix gentle and hard machines in one park?
items.a: Yes. We usually group them in separate zones. Older walkers then have a quieter corner, and younger users have room to train hard without anyone walking through.
